question: What is the description about the ruling of card "Condemn"?
evidence: Ancestor's Chosen' is the name of card; description about the ruling refers to text;
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching rulings record.
gold: SELECT T2.text FROM cards AS T1 LEFT JOIN rulings AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.name = 'Condemn'
gold0: SELECT T2.text FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN rulings AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.name = 'Condemn'

b.request: Return the ruling text for the card named “Condemn,” including the card if it has no matching ruling record
b.sql: SELECT c.name, r.text AS ruling_text FROM cards AS c LEFT JOIN rulings AS r ON r.uuid = c.uuid WHERE c.name = 'Condemn';
